title: Inventory chunk
description: Phase 1 inventory of one chunk of the app's UI code (process/02-inventory-and-map.md). One entry per user-visible part or piece of UI infrastructure. An entry's id is <chunk>.<index>, the index counting from 0 in the entries array; area maps cite entries by that id. Paths are relative to the app snapshot root. Every line reference is path:line or path:from-to.

chunk.description: Chunk id, two or more digits ("05").

name.description: The part as a user names it ("Layers panel row context menu"); infrastructure by its job ("Dock layout persistence").

kind.description: infra: code with no pixels of its own (dispatch, state, persistence, registries, glue).

lines.description: Lines of this file that belong to the entry.

ranges.description: Line ranges when the entry owns only part of the file ("40-180, 300-342").

entry_points.description: Functions the rest of the app calls to show or run the part: "path:line fn_name".

shows.description: One or two sentences: what the user sees and when.

state_reads.description: App state the part reads, each with path:line.

state_writes.description: App state the part writes, each with path:line.

commands.description: Command ids or actions it sends, each with path:line.

widgets_used.description: Widgets and helpers it builds from (app or framework), each with path:line.

interactions.description: Pointer, key, wheel, drag and focus behaviour, each with path:line.

control_reach.description: How a script reaches the part's states through the app's control channel (method and params, with path:line), or "none found" and where you looked.

count.description: #[test] functions in the file that concern this entry.

examples.description: Up to five test function names.

lines.description: Total lines of the entry: the sum of files[].lines.

notes.description: Facts a mapper needs that fit no other key (limits, platform branches, dead code), each with path:line.

skipped.description: Files of the chunk that hold no entry (a module root with only mod lines, generated code), each with the reason.
